description: A membership record in the member's own repo: the member's side of belonging to a community, as a follow is in AT Protocol (#385). The community's own net.openfederation.community.member record stays the authority; a membership record the community does not confirm is a bookmark, not a membership. Written for public communities only, since a member's repo is public.

main.description: The member's record of one community membership. The record key is the community's DID, so there is one per community.
